home-service-market.name: Home Service Market
home-service-market.description: Hayes Valley's trusted neighborhood market since serving the Western Addition and Lower Haight communities. Located on Hayes Street near Divisadero, we offer an extensive selection of craft beer, California wines, premium spirits, and everyday essentials. Whether you're hosting a dinner party in Alamo Square or grabbing supplies before a show at The Fillmore, we're your one-stop shop.
home-service-market.headline: Hayes Valley Liquor & Market

hours.weekday: Mon-Thu: 9 AM - 9 PM, Fri: 9 AM - 10 PM
hours.weekend: Sat: 9 AM - 10 PM, Sun: 9 AM - 9 PM

faqs.question: What are your store hours?
faqs.answer: We're open Monday-Thursday 9 AM - 9 PM, Friday-Saturday 9 AM - 10 PM, and Sunday 9 AM - 9 PM.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We're at 1700 Hayes St in San Francisco's Hayes Valley neighborhood, near the corner of Hayes and Shrader, just a few blocks from Alamo Square Park.

faqs.question: What's the closest liquor store to Alamo Square Park?
faqs.answer: Home Service Market is just a few blocks from Alamo Square Park at 1700 Hayes St — perfect for picking up wine, beer, or snacks before enjoying the Painted Ladies view.

faqs.question: Where can I buy craft beer near the Fillmore?
faqs.answer: We're on Hayes Street, minutes from The Fillmore. Stop by before or after a show for local SF craft beers, IPAs, and a wide selection of domestic and imported options.

faqs.question: Do you sell ice and mixers?
faqs.answer: Yes! We carry bags of ice, tonic water, soda, juices, bitters, and all the essentials for making cocktails at home.

faqs.question: What wine goes well with a dinner party?
faqs.answer: For a crowd-pleasing dinner wine, we recommend a California Cabernet Sauvignon or Pinot Noir in the $15-25 range. Our staff can help you pick the perfect bottle based on your menu.

faqs.question: Are you open on holidays?
faqs.answer: We're open most holidays with adjusted hours. Call us at (415) 346-7000 to confirm.

faqs.question: Do you carry non-alcoholic options?
faqs.answer: Yes — non-alcoholic beers, wines, and spirits, plus sodas, energy drinks, water, and juices.

faqs.question: What's the best bourbon under $30?
faqs.answer: We carry several excellent bourbons under $30 including Buffalo Trace, Evan Williams Single Barrel, and Wild Turkey 101. Ask our staff for their pick.

faqs.question: Can I buy single beers or do I need to buy a pack?
faqs.answer: We sell individual cans and bottles so you can mix and match to try different styles.

faqs.question: Where can I find a liquor store in Hayes Valley?
faqs.answer: Home Service Market is Hayes Valley's neighborhood liquor and convenience store at 1700 Hayes St, near Hayes and Shrader. Open daily.

faqs.question: Do you sell cigarettes and tobacco?
faqs.answer: Yes, we carry cigarettes, cigars, and tobacco products. Valid ID required.

faqs.question: What's the difference between bourbon and whiskey?
faqs.answer: All bourbon is whiskey, but not all whiskey is bourbon. Bourbon must be made in the USA from at least 51% corn and aged in new charred oak barrels. We carry both.

faqs.question: Do you have good wines under $15?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Menage a Trois, Line 39, and imports from Chile and Argentina are all great quality under $15.

faqs.question: Can I walk to your store from NOPA or the Western Addition?
faqs.answer: Yes! We're right on the border of Hayes Valley and the Western Addition — easy walking from NOPA, the Panhandle, and Lower Haight.

faqs.question: Do you sell lottery tickets?
faqs.answer: Yes, we sell California Lottery tickets including Scratchers and draw games.

faqs.question: What snacks do you carry?
faqs.answer: Chips, nuts, jerky, candy, gum, and other grab-and-go snacks — perfect for pairing with your drinks.

faqs.question: Is there parking near your store?
faqs.answer: Street parking is available on Hayes St and surrounding blocks, usually within a block or two.

faqs.question: What's the best wine to bring to a housewarming?
faqs.answer: A Napa Valley Cabernet or a sparkling wine always impresses. Budget $20-35 for something special. We can help you choose.

faqs.question: Do you accept credit cards?
faqs.answer: Yes — all major credit cards, debit cards, and cash.

faqs.question: What are the alcohol buying hours in California?
faqs.answer: Alcohol can be sold between 6:00 AM and 2:00 AM daily in California. Our store hours fall within these times.

faqs.question: Can you recommend a good tequila for margaritas?
faqs.answer: For margaritas, go with a blanco tequila — Espolón, Olmeca Altos, or Casamigos Blanco are excellent without breaking the bank.

faqs.question: Do you carry San Francisco Bay Area craft beers?
faqs.answer: Yes! We stock local favorites from Anchor Brewing, Fort Point, Cellarmaker, and other Bay Area producers.

faqs.question: What's the cheapest beer you sell?
faqs.answer: We carry budget-friendly domestics like Budweiser, Coors, PBR, and Natural Light in cans and packs.

faqs.question: Do you offer delivery?
faqs.answer: We don't currently offer delivery, but we're conveniently located with street parking available. Stop by and browse our full selection in-store!

reviews.name: Michael R.
reviews.text: Best selection in Hayes Valley. The staff really knows their stuff!

reviews.name: Sarah L.
reviews.text: Love this place! Great prices and they always have what I'm looking for.

reviews.name: David K.
reviews.text: Convenient location near Alamo Square. My go-to spot for wine.

town-country-market.name: Town Country Market
town-country-market.tagline: Nob Hill's premier wine & spirits destination
town-country-market.description: Serving San Francisco's prestigious Nob Hill and Union Square neighborhoods from our Post Street location. Steps from the historic Fairmont Hotel and cable car lines, we offer a curated selection of fine wines, premium spirits, and gourmet provisions. Perfect for hotel guests, theater-goers, and discerning locals seeking quality beverages in the heart of downtown San Francisco.
town-country-market.headline: Nob Hill Wine & Spirits

faqs.question: What are your store hours?
faqs.answer: We're open 7 days a week from 8 AM to 12 AM (midnight). Perfect for late-night needs!

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We're at 600 Post St in San Francisco's Nob Hill neighborhood, just steps from Union Square and the historic Fairmont Hotel.

faqs.question: What liquor store is closest to the Fairmont Hotel?
faqs.answer: Town Country Market is steps from the Fairmont at 600 Post St — the most convenient option for Fairmont, Mark Hopkins, and Huntington Hotel guests.

faqs.question: Is there a liquor store near Union Square open late?
faqs.answer: Yes! We're open until midnight, 7 days a week — the latest hours of any liquor store near Union Square.

faqs.question: Where can I buy wine near the Powell Street cable car?
faqs.answer: We're a short walk from the Powell-Hyde and Powell-Mason cable car lines. Head up Post Street from Union Square to 600 Post St.

faqs.question: Do you carry champagne for a celebration?
faqs.answer: Everything from budget-friendly Prosecco and Cava to Moët, Veuve Clicquot, and Dom Pérignon.

faqs.question: What's the best wine to bring back from San Francisco as a souvenir?
faqs.answer: A Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon or Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir — both iconic California wines that travel well.

faqs.question: Can I buy alcohol after 10 PM in San Francisco?
faqs.answer: Yes! California allows sales until 2 AM. Town Country Market is open until midnight daily.

faqs.question: Where's the nearest liquor store to the Tenderloin?
faqs.answer: We're at 600 Post St, right on the Nob Hill/Tenderloin border — easy walking distance from anywhere in the neighborhood.

faqs.question: Do you sell mini bottles?
faqs.answer: Yes — 50ml nips in whiskey, vodka, rum, tequila, and more. Perfect for hotel rooms or travel.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Prosecco and Champagne?
faqs.answer: Champagne is from France, more complex and expensive. Prosecco is Italian, lighter, and more affordable. Both are sparkling wines — we carry both.

faqs.question: Are you open on New Year's Eve?
faqs.answer: Yes! Open until midnight on NYE and most holidays.

faqs.question: Where can I buy sake near Chinatown?
faqs.answer: We're a few blocks from Chinatown. We stock premium Japanese sake including junmai, ginjo, daiginjo, and nigori styles.

faqs.question: Do you carry imported wines from France and Italy?
faqs.answer: Yes — French Bordeaux, Burgundy, Rhône, plus Italian Chianti, Barolo, and Prosecco alongside California wines.

faqs.question: What's a good whiskey gift under $50?
faqs.answer: Maker's Mark, Woodford Reserve, Bulleit Bourbon, or Jameson Black Barrel. Our staff can tailor the recommendation.

faqs.question: Is there a convenience store near the San Francisco Masonic?
faqs.answer: We're about a 10-minute walk from the Masonic. Stop by before or after events.

faqs.question: Do you sell cold beer?
faqs.answer: Yes — a wide selection kept cold and ready to drink, including craft, domestic, and imported.

faqs.question: What red wine pairs well with steak?
faqs.answer: Napa Cabernet Sauvignon is the classic. Malbec and Syrah/Shiraz also pair beautifully. We can find the perfect bottle.

faqs.question: Where can tourists buy alcohol in San Francisco?
faqs.answer: Any liquor store in SF sells alcohol. Town Country Market at 600 Post St is centrally located near Union Square hotels and open late.

faqs.question: Do you carry cocktail mixers and garnishes?
faqs.answer: Yes — tonic water, club soda, ginger beer, bitters, citrus juices, and all cocktail essentials.

faqs.question: What's the legal drinking age in California?
faqs.answer: 21 years old. We check ID for all alcohol purchases.

faqs.question: Can you recommend a wine for someone who doesn't usually drink wine?
faqs.answer: Moscato (sweet, light), Pinot Grigio (crisp, easy), or Rosé (refreshing) are great starting points. We love helping people discover wines.

faqs.question: Is your store wheelchair accessible?
faqs.answer: Yes, we're accessible from street level at 600 Post St.

faqs.question: Do you carry Japanese whisky?
faqs.answer: Select Japanese whiskies when available — they're often allocated and sell quickly. Call ahead to check stock.

faqs.question: Do you offer delivery?
faqs.answer: We don't currently offer delivery, but our central downtown location makes us easy to reach. We're near several MUNI lines and the Powell Street cable car.

reviews.name: Jennifer M.
reviews.text: Great selection and open late! Perfect when staying at nearby hotels.

reviews.name: Robert T.
reviews.text: The staff recommendations are always spot-on. My go-to in Nob Hill.

reviews.name: Amanda H.
reviews.text: Convenient location near Union Square. Good prices for downtown.

mmc-wine-spirit.name: MMC Wine & Spirit
mmc-wine-spirit.tagline: Fine wines & premium spirits in Union Square
mmc-wine-spirit.description: Located on Sutter Street in the heart of San Francisco's Union Square district, MMC Wine & Spirit has been the destination for collectors and connoisseurs seeking rare wines and exceptional spirits. Walking distance from the Theater District, Chinatown, and luxury hotels, we specialize in hard-to-find Japanese whisky, single malt scotch, and boutique California wines. Our expert staff provides personalized recommendations for every palate and budget.
mmc-wine-spirit.headline: Union Square Fine Wines & Rare Spirits

hours.weekday: Mon-Thu: 10 AM - 11 PM, Fri: 10 AM - 12 AM
hours.weekend: Sat: 10 AM - 12 AM, Sun: 10 AM - 11 PM

faqs.question: What are your store hours?
faqs.answer: We're open Monday-Thursday 10 AM - 11 PM, Friday-Saturday 10 AM - 12 AM, and Sunday 10 AM - 11 PM.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We're at 615 Sutter St in San Francisco's Union Square district, between Mason and Taylor, walking distance from the Theater District and major hotels.

faqs.question: Where can I find rare Japanese whisky in San Francisco?
faqs.answer: MMC Wine & Spirit specializes in hard-to-find Japanese whisky — Yamazaki, Hibiki, Hakushu, Nikka. We maintain a waitlist for allocated releases.

faqs.question: What's the best liquor store near the SF Theater District?
faqs.answer: We're walking distance from all major theaters on Geary Street at 615 Sutter St, between Mason and Taylor.

faqs.question: Do you carry allocated or limited-edition bourbons?
faqs.answer: Yes — Buffalo Trace Antique Collection, Pappy Van Winkle, Weller. Call (415) 474-4951 for our waitlist.

faqs.question: Where's the nearest wine shop to the Westin St. Francis?
faqs.answer: A short walk — head one block north of Union Square on Sutter Street to 615 Sutter St.

faqs.question: What single malt scotch do you recommend for a beginner?
faqs.answer: Glenlivet 12 (smooth), Glenfiddich 12 (light), or Macallan 12 (rich). All under $60 and excellent starting points.

faqs.question: Can I pre-order a specific bottle?
faqs.answer: Yes! We special order most wines and spirits. For rare bottles, call (415) 474-4951 for our waitlist.

faqs.question: What's the most expensive whisky you carry?
faqs.answer: Our premium shelf typically ranges $200-$500+, including rare Japanese whisky, single cask scotch, and limited bourbon. Visit to see current selection.

faqs.question: Where can I buy boutique California wines in San Francisco?
faqs.answer: We curate small-production wines from Napa, Sonoma, Paso Robles, and Santa Barbara that you won't find in grocery stores.

faqs.question: Is there a liquor store near Chinatown with good whisky?
faqs.answer: We're on the edge of Chinatown at 615 Sutter St with one of downtown SF's best whisky selections — scotch, bourbon, Japanese, Irish, and rye.

faqs.question: What's the difference between single malt and blended scotch?
faqs.answer: Single malt is from one distillery using malted barley — more distinct character. Blended combines multiple distilleries — typically smoother. We carry excellent examples of both.

faqs.question: Do you offer gift wrapping or gift bags?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide gift bags for bottle purchases — perfect for hotel gifts, dinner parties, or special occasions.

faqs.question: What mezcal brands do you carry?
faqs.answer: Artisanal mezcals including Del Maguey, Montelobos, Banhez, and other small-batch producers.

faqs.question: Where can I buy cognac or brandy near Union Square?
faqs.answer: We carry Hennessy, Rémy Martin, Courvoisier, and boutique producers at 615 Sutter St, one block from Union Square.

faqs.question: What wine should I pair with seafood?
faqs.answer: Sauvignon Blanc, Chablis, or Albariño for light fish. Light Pinot Noir for richer fish like salmon. Our staff can match wine to your specific dish.

faqs.question: Do you carry natural or organic wines?
faqs.answer: Yes — biodynamic, organic, and minimal-intervention wines from California and Europe. This selection is growing.

faqs.question: What's a good housewarming gift from a liquor store?
faqs.answer: Quality champagne ($30-60), premium bourbon like Woodford Reserve, or Napa Cabernet. We suggest the perfect bottle for any budget.

faqs.question: Is there a liquor store near the Hilton Union Square?
faqs.answer: 3-minute walk — head north on Mason St to Sutter. We're at 615 Sutter St.

faqs.question: What's the best aperitif or digestif?
faqs.answer: Aperitifs: Aperol, Campari, Lillet. Digestifs: Fernet-Branca, Amaro Montenegro, fine port. We stock a wide range of Italian amari and French aperitifs.

faqs.question: Can your staff help me choose a wine or spirit?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Our staff are enthusiasts who love matching customers to the right bottle — first-timers and collectors alike.

faqs.question: What vermouth do you carry for Negronis or Martinis?
faqs.answer: Carpano Antica Formula, Dolin, Cocchi di Torino, and Noilly Prat — everything for a perfect Negroni, Manhattan, or Martini.

faqs.question: Where can I find a gift for a whiskey collector?
faqs.answer: We often have limited releases, single cask bottlings, and rare finds. Call ahead or visit — our special bottles change frequently.

faqs.question: Do you offer delivery?
faqs.answer: We don't currently offer delivery. Visit us in-store to browse our extensive collection and get personalized recommendations from our expert staff.

faqs.question: Do you ship bottles?
faqs.answer: We don't ship, but we're centrally located near Union Square — easy to reach by MUNI, cable car, or rideshare.
